records.entry: **Proposed answer** - **Observation:** The verified findings in the Archive contain two independent reports about the Zaporizhzhia airstrike: 1. *StratNewsGlobal* (2024‑12‑10) – “A Russian strike on Wednesday killed at least 13 people and injured 63.” 2. *The Moscow Times* (2024‑12‑10) – “Three people were killed … rescuers are searching for people under the rubble of a clinic destroyed by a Russian missile.” - **Inference:** Both sources are reputable news outlets that differ from the claim “at least 20 killed and 18 injured.” The *StratNewsGlobal* article gives the alternate figure **13 killed, 63 injured** (same date as the claim). The *Moscow Times* article gives the alternate figure **3 killed** (no injury count provided) for the same date. - **Answer:** An independent public source that reports a casualty figure different from “at least 20 killed and 18 injured” is **StratNewsGlobal**, which states that **13 people were killed and 63 were injured** in the Zaporizhzhia residential‑building strike (reported on 10 December 2024). A second independent source, **The Moscow Times**, reports **3 people killed** (with no injury figure) for the same incident. **Concrete test to verify the answer** 1. **Locate the articles** - Retrieve the article at `https://stratnewsglobal.com/europe/ukraine-europe/russian-strike-kills-13-in-ukrainian-city-of-zaporizhzhia/`. - Retrieve the article at `https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2024/12/10/russian-strike-kills-3-in-ukraines-zaporizhzhia-says-governor-a87288`. 2. **Check the headline and body** for the casualty numbers reported. - Confirm that the StratNewsGlobal piece mentions “killed at least 13 people and injured 63.” - Confirm that the Moscow Times piece mentions “Three people were killed” (and note any injury data, if present). 3. **Validate the publication dates** (both 10 December 2024) to ensure they refer to the same airstrike event. If both articles contain the stated figures, the answer is confirmed; if either article is missing or reports different numbers, the answer must be revised.
